articles.title: 18-year-old Anahat's historic run at Silicon Valley Open comes to an end
articles.description: India’s Anahat Singh exited the Silicon Valley Open after losing 3-1 to Malaysia’s Sivasangari Subramaniam despite winning the opening game. Sivasangari praised the 18-year-old’s talent and potential after staging a comeback. Anahat had earlier defeated world No. 14 Salma Hany to become the first Indian woman since 2019 to reach a PSA Tour Gold-level semifinal.

articles.title: Tumaini Trial Launch: WHO begins Ebola vaccine study in DRC; aims to protect against Bundibugyo strain
articles.description: In a historic move, the World Health Organization has launched its inaugural clinical trial for an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of Congo. This trial aims to assess the efficacy of the Ervebo vaccine against the Bundibugyo virus amid a severe outbreak that has resulted in over 9,700 cases and 4,600 fatalities since May.

articles.description: Selena Gomez proudly hosted the fourth annual Rare Impact Fund Benefit in Los Angeles, successfully raising significant funds for mental health initiatives. The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team. articles.title: Watch: Giant waves crash into Taiwan as Typhoon Champi leaves over 500 injured; 1 dead
articles.description: Typhoon Champi made landfall in Taiwan, resulting in one casualty and more than 500 injuries reported. The storm brought heavy rain and strong winds, leading to widespread power outages affecting over 167,000 homes. Over 240 flights were canceled due to severe weather conditions impacting transport services. Schools and offices were closed for an extended period as a precautionary measure against the storm.

articles.title: Mrbeast Bets On Ai Toy: Star takes 55% of Ball 2; viral hype must prove lasting demand
articles.description: MrBeast invested $250,000 for a 55% stake in Ball 2, an AI-powered toy, during his debut on Shark Tank. Created by Andrew Brown and Kevin Langdon, the ball uses sensors and a companion app to track movement and generate interactive games. While MrBeast backed its viral potential, investors Kevin O'Leary and Lori Greiner questioned consumer demand. The product's success now depends on turning online attention into lasting sales.

articles.description: India’s foreign exchange reserves fell by $5.01 billion to $721.02 billion in the week ended Oct 16, down $64.7 billion from their all-time high of $785.71 billion in the week ended Sept 4, as pressure on the rupee continued. articles.title: UP Board exams 2027: UPMSP sets October 26 deadline for schools to submit classes 9 to 12 student lists
articles.description: UPMSP has granted 940 schools an extended deadline until October 26, 2026, for student registrations. Schools must generate and submit student lists along with required documents to the District School Inspector. This follows previously missed deadlines on October 15 and October 22. The board has outlined examination schedules for Class 10 and Class 12, set from February 5 to 24, 2027.

articles.title: UGC NET December 2026: Facing live photo capture issues? NTA shares steps to resolve them
articles.description: Candidates facing issues capturing live photographs for the UGC NET December 2026 application should follow NTA's guidance. They are advised to ensure proper lighting and a clear background for their photographs. If issues persist, candidates can clear their browser cache or switch browsers to try again. Furthermore, assistance is available through the official NTA website or helpdesk contact. The exam is scheduled for December 14 to 19, 2026.

articles.title: Tiger Shroff firing incident prompts FWICE security advisory
articles.description: Following a concerning shooting event, FWICE has released a statement demanding stronger security protocols for film and television production activities. The federation highlights the importance of conducting comprehensive background checks on all individuals working on set. Moreover, it insists on enhanced credential verification and precise record management at filming locations, ensuring the safety of every crew member and technician. To effectively enact these recommendations, industry collaboration is essential.

articles.title: 'Jailer 2' faces controversy in Tamil Nadu
articles.description: A song was mistakenly played instead of India's National Anthem before the screening of 'Jailer 2'. This incident occurred at Ajantha Ellora Cinemas in Karur, Tamil Nadu, causing significant public attention. Despite the controversy, 'Jailer 2' continues to perform well at the box office, though collections declined recently. Nelson Dilipkumar directed the film, which reunites him with Rajinikanth from their previous collaboration.

articles.title: Danielle Parton to join the brand ambassador of Dolly Parton’s estate
articles.description: In a heartfelt tribute, Danielle Parton steps into the role of brand ambassador for her beloved aunt Dolly Parton's estate. Dedicated to honoring Dolly’s remarkable legacy, Danielle is inspired to share intimate stories and lessons learned from her aunt’s life. Following Dolly’s recent passing at the age of 80, she feels a deep commitment to preserving their family history and championing the causes that mattered so much to her aunt.
